title: Section C SC-14: ALCHEMY_URL is required while ETH_RPC_URL is the documented key, preflight then refuses an ALCHEMY_URL-only setup that the registry accepts, process.env.ALCHEMY_URL! assertions hide the fallback, and chain addresses and gas settings exist twice (legacy CONFIG and CHAIN_TEMPLATES)

evidence.note: ALCHEMY_URL required: true ('legacy, use ETH_RPC_URL instead')
rpc.sepolia / rpc.mainnet = ETH_RPC_URL || ALCHEMY_URL! ; rpc.bsc falls back to a public BSC endpoint
eth falls back to ALCHEMY_URL when ETH_RPC_URL is unset
Rule 4 fails eth when ETH_RPC_URL is unset, ignoring the ALCHEMY_URL fallback
NETWORK defaults to 'sepolia' while .env.example:55 ships NETWORK=mainnet; the value only picks the legacy provider key
legacy ETH factory/router/WETH addresses, gasMultiplier 1.2 and gasLimit 300000 duplicated from CHAIN_TEMPLATES.eth (chainRegistry.ts:179-204)

consumers: tokenSafety.ts legacy functions (not called on the multi-chain path; bot.ts imports simulateSwap but never calls it), gasManager.ts:41 (unreachable, SC-19), pairDiscovery.ts:11-14 (unreachable, SC-20), scripts/addLiquidity.ts
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S2): RPC validation contradicts the supported per-chain URL configuration

sibling_sites_checked: All rpc / address duplicates in the slice listed in evidence. Outside: provider.ts:16-19 uses CONFIG.network / CONFIG.rpc as the legacy fallback key (TX slice). The multi-chain buy and exit paths read ctx.chain (CHAIN_TEMPLATES) only; no live path was found using the legacy addresses.
severity_rationale: S3: misleading configuration and drift risk. Today the live paths use one source (CHAIN_TEMPLATES), and the contradictory ETH RPC rules fail closed (preflight refuses), so no capital effect.
recommendation: Make ETH_RPC_URL the required key (ALCHEMY_URL an explicit alias resolved in one place), drop the non-null assertions, and remove the legacy CONFIG addresses and gas values with their dead consumers. Card DB-06 (env contract). Phase 27/29.
